710137.en: Someone witnessed several sneaky black-robed persons performing a ritual in the wild.
710137.ch: 有人在荒野中目击到，几名行踪诡异的黑袍人在进行着某种仪式。

710138.en: Rumors say that there was a bloodbath recently close to {positionName|1401}. A Nether Demon lurked about and attacked passing Cultivators. Due to its ruthlessness and unpredictability, no one has been able to exterminate it yet, and there have been hundreds of casualties so far. The Cultivators {1}, {2}, {3}, and others from the Cultivator Alliance have been tragically killed.
710138.ch: 传闻近期{positionName|1401}附近发生了一起血案，有冥妖潜伏此地袭击过路的修仙者，由于其手段狠辣、神出鬼没，尚无人能将其灭杀，截至目前已造成数百人员伤亡。仙盟中的修仙者{1}、{2}、{3}等已然不幸遇害。

710139.en: According to witnesses, a Nether Demon appeared close to {positionName|1402} and wantonly attacked humans. The demon is exceptionally strong, and is still causing great damage. {1}, {2}, {3}, and others from the Cultivator Alliance have already been killed.
710139.ch: 据目击者称，{positionName|1402}附近出现了大肆攻击人类的冥妖，此妖实力异常强大、以一敌百，目前仍在行凶作乱之中。仙盟麾下的{1}、{2}、{3}等修仙者已横遭毒手。

710140.en: Recently, there has been a sudden increase in the concentration of Nether Air close to {positionName|1403}. It is suspected that this is due to Nether Demons. The Cultivator Alliance has sent hundreds of the righteous to explore the area, but none of them have returned, including {1}, {2}, {3}, and other skilled members.
710140.ch: 近日{positionName|1403}附近冥气浓度陡然提升，疑似有冥妖在此作乱，仙盟派遣数百正义之士前往一探却均有去无回，其中包括{1}、{2}、{3}等仙盟之才。

710141.en: Recently, hundreds of Cultivators have disappeared mysteriously at {positionName|1404}. The Cultivator Alliance is highly suspicious that an unknown small amount of Nether Demon forces have invaded this place and are devouring humans to grow their strength. Poor {1}, {2}, {3} and other loyal people have died.
710141.ch: 近期{positionName|1404}数百修仙者神秘失踪，仙盟方严重怀疑是有未知的小股冥妖力量入侵了此地并吞噬人类进行成长所致，可怜{1}、{2}、{3}等我族忠良一命呜呼。

710142.en: Rumors say that a demonic Cultivator has appeared close to {positionName|1405}.
